name: Route Planner
tagline: Email it your stops and vans; it replies with optimised delivery routes, a map and a CSV.
description:
Send the depot and the stops with their coordinates (and how much each needs), and how many vans you have. It plans the routes with Google's OR-tools solver, respecting van capacity, and replies with each van's order of stops, distance and time.

For a rush-hour departure, times include a slowdown measured in a SUMO traffic simulation.

capabilities.name: Vehicle routing
capabilities.description: Shortest routes across several vans with capacity limits.

capabilities.name: Rush-hour times
capabilities.description: Adjusted with a SUMO traffic simulation.

capabilities.name: Map and CSV
capabilities.description: Each route drawn on a map and listed stop by stop.
